scope: El Salvador medical discovery — Universidad Evangélica de El Salvador Doctorado en Medicina

verifiedFacts.claim: UEES lists Doctorado en Medicina as an in-person programme and states that its clinical practice is delivered across three national hospital sites, without naming those sites on the page reviewed.

UEES's official 2026 fee schedule lists Doctorado en Medicina (presential) with a $125 enrolment fee, six instalments per cycle, a $170–$355 instalment range, $5 insurance and $70 educational service charge. Its current admissions page separately lists a $40 preparatory course charge.

UEES says its Doctorado en Medicina holds international accreditation through RIEV and COMAEM. Its internationalisation page describes the RIEV accreditation as fully renewed in 2022 for six years; the programme page does not display a separate COMAEM validity period.

El Salvador's Consejo Superior de Salud Pública states that its medical-profession board oversees the practice of medicine and provides permanent professional-registration materials for Doctorado en Medicina graduates.

holdReasons: No complete current admissions calendar or academic and international-applicant requirements were located.

Programme duration, teaching language, named clinical hospitals, internship/service-social terms, curriculum document and student-support arrangements were not verified from current authoritative sources.
The university's COMAEM claim needs a directly verifiable accreditor record and validity date before it can be used as a formal recognition statement.
nextAction: Obtain UEES's current curriculum, live admissions requirements and direct confirmation of named hospital training sites and COMAEM validity before considering a payload.
